scope: Swappable J:/P: and caller-accessible NDSCAN in disposable CP/M 3/Z3PLUS media; published 1.0 is unchanged.

package_check.public_redistribution: not assessed by runtime checks; see docs/distribution-review.md

host_device_tests.method: Compile actual emulator/rcpm_mount.c with strict warnings and sparse image fixtures; exercise legacy J and new P protocol, independent default restoration, wrong sizes, invalid/missing/nonregular/truncated images and catalog filtering.

windows_runtime.status: cross-compiled and system-DLL audited; new runtime not executed in Windows

methods.ndview: Test-only approved guest viewer reads and prints the actual resident NDR, verifying all 16 P: names, stale-name removal, default restoration and preservation of non-P: entries.
methods.capacity: Test-only guest commands temporarily reduce ENV NDR capacity to 8 and restore 42. Overflowing scan leaves the entire table unchanged, compared after capacity restoration.
methods.permission_write: Test-only approved program attempts MAKE/WRITE/CLOSE/FLUSH on P4:NEWFILE.TXT. Default denies, private AUTH P4:RW allows after unblanking, NDSCAN preserves the grant, and revocation denies again. Data verified with stopped-host cpmtools.
methods.flush_fault: Test AUTH/MOUNT binaries intercept only BDOS 48, returning FF; all other calls reach real CP/M.

limits: No induced physical disk failure or power loss.
Raw image size validation does not prove filesystem validity.
Mount succeeds before the separately chained NDSCAN; scan errors preserve old names while new media remains mounted.
Windows binaries compiled/audited only; do not carry forward the old 1.0 Windows runtime qualification to this feature.
